name: Playwright (Browser & E2E Testing)
ai_instructions: To test web pages, verify UI rendering, or capture screenshots of localhost/external apps, run 'node tools/playwright_runner.js <URL> [output.png]'. Review captured console errors and screenshot outputs before verifying frontend fixes.

claude_command.name: playwright
claude_command.content:
# /playwright <url> [screenshot_path]

Automate headless browser inspection and UI testing.

1. Run: `node tools/playwright_runner.js <url>`
2. Inspect page title, HTTP response status, and browser console errors.
3. If visual UI verification is required, inspect the generated screenshot in `.playwright/`.
4. Summarize test results concisely with pass/fail status.
